parsed.name: QuTech量子波形发生器
parsed.description: 用于量子实验控制的波形发生设备，可生成精确定时的控制信号，并支持数字I/O接口的校准与协议同步，以配合量子测控系统运行。
parsed.description_en: A waveform generation instrument for quantum experiments, used to produce precisely timed control signals and to support digital I/O calibration and protocol synchronization with quantum control electronics.

actions.description: 执行数字I/O（DIO）接口校准，使设备与外部控制系统的时序和数据对齐。
actions.description_en: Perform digital I/O (DIO) interface calibration to align timing and data with external control systems.

actions.description: 自动校准DIO通信协议参数，建立可靠的数字握手与同步配置。
actions.description_en: Automatically calibrate DIO protocol parameters to establish reliable digital handshaking and synchronization settings.

actions.description: 输出DIO校准数据，供检查、记录或后续配置使用。
actions.description_en: Output DIO calibration data for inspection, logging, or later configuration use.
